Today we remember Charlie Kirk. His dynamism and convictions helped inspire a generation of Americans.

The way to combat speech we don’t like is more speech, not less. Civil discourse in our great nation is what makes us better, sharper, and more American. Political violence is never acceptable and anti-American.

May we follow Charlie’s example and honor his legacy.
posts.summary: Defends free speech against censorship, opposes political violence

This week, Crawford welcomed The Traveling Vietnam Wall and Cost of Freedom Tribute.

The wall is an 80% scale replica of the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in Washington, DC. It pays tribute to those who fought and died in the Vietnam War. Crawford will hold commemorative events at the wall for the rest of the week in honor of America’s veterans.

May we never forget their sacrifice.

This morning, I joined the “Karly Rain Matters” podcast. The host is Amber Wood, the mother of Karly Rain. Karly was murdered in 2022 by a repeat violent offender.

On the episode, we discussed the Karly Rain Wood Act. I introduced this legislation to create a national violent offenders registry. This is a step to make our streets safer. Violent repeat offenders shouldn’t be allowed to freely roam our streets.
posts.summary: Supports national violent offenders registry legislation

posts.text:
Nebraska is an ag state. We are the beef state. Our farmers and ranchers feed and fuel the world.

After years of hardships and burdensome policies, our agriculture communities need long-term solutions, not temporary fixes.

I appreciate this Administration working to rebuild the herd, support recovery efforts, and cut regulatory red tape. American ag producers should remain our priority.
posts.summary: Calls for long-term agricultural solutions beyond temporary fixes

It was a pleasure to host @SecRollins  and @SenatorFischer at my third annual Federal Issues Forum this week.

There is no better place than the Nebraska State Fair to talk about how we are fighting to protect the Good Life for every Nebraskan.

Nebraska producers are the best in the business. I will keep working to ensure that federal policies put our farmers and ranchers first. Agriculture is more than what we do, it’s our way of life.
